label: B25-BOARD-RUNNER-AST-COMPAT-SEAL
title: Remove PowerShell AST/seal binder ambiguity and complete remote no-hardware bundle validation
triggered_by: T-035 successfully bootstrapped and uploaded the corrected bundle, then failed in validate_scripts.ps1 with Argument types do not match before parse results or seal.
scope: Copy and hash-verify the exact T-035 bundle, change only validate_scripts.ps1 and verify_seal.ps1 to remove PowerShell dynamic binder ambiguity, then complete fresh GamePC AST and hash validation. All hardware paths remain unexecuted.

required_corrections.validate_scripts: Use explicitly typed System.Management.Automation.Language.Token[] and ParseError[] variables for Parser::ParseFile refs. Use ordinary PowerShell arrays for records/failures and never Generic.List with @($list).
required_corrections.verify_seal: Use ordinary PowerShell arrays for records and direct array serialization; remove Generic.List/@($list) binder ambiguity.
required_corrections.unchanged: The other seven reusable bundle files remain byte-identical to T-035, including the compatible bootstrap and preflight fail-closed gate.

acceptance.provenance: All T-035 source hashes checked before copy; exact two-file diffs and seven unchanged hashes recorded.
acceptance.local: bash -n, py_compile, manifest, consumer/root, transport prohibition and single-use/preflight control-flow audits pass.
acceptance.freshness: T-036 remote root/bootstrap absent and never overwrite/delete; bootstrap exactly once through pwsh -File and one sealed bundle upload.
acceptance.ast: validate_scripts.ps1 invoked only with pwsh -File; all six PowerShell files have parse_error_count=0 and result PASS.
acceptance.seal: verify_seal.ps1 invoked only with pwsh -File; all nine bundle file bytes/SHA match manifest and result PASS.
acceptance.boundary: Only filesystem/AST/SHA operations. Hardware/JTAG/process enumeration, programmer, terminal, server, FPGA configuration, Flash/reset/power counts all zero.
acceptance.consumer: Evidence freezes exact final bundle directory, manifest/hash and per-file hashes for byte-identical consumption by the next board task.

resource: One gamepc lock window for fresh filesystem/AST/hash validation; no heavy EDA.
forbidden_regions: hardware/JTAG/process query, quartus_pgm, nios2-terminal, server start/stop or FPGA configuration
JIC/EPCQ/Flash, reset, power or process termination
reuse/overwrite T-035 remote paths, inline PowerShell, replacement upload or retry
any semantic change outside validate_scripts.ps1 and verify_seal.ps1

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven; one-hour maximum wait; no frequent polling

result.remote_seal: PASS; 9/9 bundle bytes and SHA256 match
